findings.claim: MessagePack and DataContract attributes on the formatted type are ignored: when no surrogate is supplied, generation always switches to alphabetical contractless string-key members. Consequently [Key], [IgnoreMember], [DataMember], and related annotations on T do not control the generated wire format, contrary to the requirement that attributes on T be honoured.

receipt_plan.detail:
For a referenced type [MessagePackObject] P with [Key(0)] public int A { get; set; } and [IgnoreMember] public int B { get; set; }, generate [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] partial class PF : IMessagePackFormatter

and serialize P { A = 7, B = 9 }. Compare its bytes with those from the existing source-generated formatter for the same annotated shape. The new formatter produces a string-key map containing both A and B instead of the one-element integer-key array containing only A.
